title: Llama meets EU: Investigating the European Political Spectrum through the Lens of LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating political knowledge and biases (political leanings) within the European Union political landscape using the EUANDI questionnaire as a benchmark. While it assesses stances on social issues that have moral dimensions (e.g., euthanasia, same-sex marriage), these are treated as political policy positions rather than a benchmarking of religious, spiritual, or ethical frameworks. Standard sections on ethics and limitations are excluded from this classification as per the instructions.
